parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (0.8544) as it performed worse than our current best (0.8360). It seems the current configuration of DEPTH 6, ASPECT_RATIO 48, LR 0.045, WD 0.1, and BATCH 262144 is quite strong. I'll try increasing the ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if wider geometry helps without sacrificing optimizer steps.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity while maintaining the successful DEPTH 6 and small batch configuration.
